description: This PHP file defines a dashboard widget ('Dashlet') class for the AOK_Knowledge_Base_Categories module in SuiteCRM. It includes class constructor logic for initializing dashlet data, setting display titles, and defining search and column configurations, extending the DashletGeneric base class.

classes.name: AOK_Knowledge_Base_CategoriesDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class extending DashletGeneric for displaying and configuring the AOK_Knowledge_Base_Categories module in the SuiteCRM dashboard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the dashlet's title, search fields, columns, and seed bean, loading necessary metadata and language strings.
